doc.name: noinfra-mcp
doc.instructions: NoInfra capabilities change independently of the agent runtime. Before saying a capability is unavailable, use noinfra.tools.search to fetch the current authorized tools and schemas. Call discovered tools with noinfra.tools.call using {name, arguments}; keep idempotency_key inside arguments. A cached list is not complete. Honor setup requirements, owner approvals and spending limits returned by NoInfra. Never retry an uncertain write with a new key.
